decision_conditions: LS.01 (Proposed Landscape Strategy Plan & Section / Elevations); Landscape Strategy Statement dated 04 July 2025; Discharge of Condition 08 Statement dated 04 July 2025.
description: Approval of details pursuant to condition 8 (landscape design strategy) of planning permission ref. P2023/0323/FUL dated 01/08/2024 (Change of use of first floor from Use Class F.1 (Learning and non-residential institutions) to Class E (Nursery) to facilitate the amalgamation of ground and first floor to form a Day Nursery. Installation of storage for 2no. bicycles, installation of a new entrance door and new window to the St Paul's Road frontage. Installation of storage for 2no. bicycles at the rear with associated landscaping works, part demolition of a listed wall and partial demolition of adjoining garages to create external play space; installation of a new brick wall to replace the partially demolished wall; installation of replacement brick wall to rear yard.)
